run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the minimum distance between two numbers x and y in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets and print success count
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to handle edge cases where x or y are not present in the array
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that tracks previous index of x or y to compute minimum distance
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which finds minimum index distance between two target values in an array
